data.title: Study Enrollment Form
data.description: Baseline characterization of each animal subject at the time of study enrollment.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete this form **once per subject**, on the day the animal enters the study and before any injury procedure.

## Required items
All Core items must be completed. Strain and Genotype are important whenever a transgenic line is used.

## Notes
Subject ID must be unique across the entire study and immutable once assigned.

items.label: Baseline Measurements
items.instructions: Record age and body weight at enrollment.

data.title: Controlled Cortical Impact (CCI) Injury Procedure Form
data.description: Complete record of the surgical procedure and impact parameters for a CCI injury or sham control.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete **immediately following** the injury procedure while the animal is recovering.

## Required items
All impact parameters (velocity, actuator, craniotomy coordinates) must be recorded. Body temperature is recorded at the start and end of the procedure using this form twice if needed.

## Sham controls
For Sham subjects, complete the craniotomy coordinates section but leave Impact Velocity and Impact Actuator empty.

items.label: Anesthesia
items.instructions: Record the agent used to induce and maintain anesthesia during the procedure.

items.label: Surgical Procedure
items.instructions: Stereotaxic craniotomy location relative to bregma.

items.label: Impact Parameters
items.instructions: Complete for CCI and Weight Drop injuries; leave blank for Sham.

data.title: Post-Injury Daily Monitoring Log
data.description: Daily welfare monitoring log for the acute post-injury period.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete **once daily** for the first 7 days following injury. Thereafter, weekly for the remainder of the study.

## Priority observations
Any Racine score ≥ 3 or an unexplained ≥15% drop in body weight should trigger an additional Seizure Event Form or veterinary review.

items.label: Observed Seizure Activity
items.instructions: If any seizure activity is observed, also complete a dedicated Seizure Event Form.

data.title: EEG Recording Session Form
data.description: Session-level metadata and acquisition parameters for continuous or event-triggered EEG recording.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete **at the start of each recording session**, before initiating data acquisition.

## Electrode placement
If electrode coordinates changed from a prior session (e.g., after re-implantation), annotate this in the notes field on the subject chart.

data.title: Seizure Event Form
data.description: Per-event characterization of spontaneous recurrent seizures.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete **for each individual seizure event**. For behavioral events, complete as soon as practical after observation; for EEG-detected events, complete during post-hoc review.

## Onset precision
Choose the most precise category that you can defend from the available evidence. When in doubt, use the broader category.

data.title: Morris Water Maze Session Form
data.description: Trial-level record for Morris Water Maze spatial learning assessment.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
One row per trial; complete immediately after each trial. Typical protocol is 4 trials per day for 5 consecutive days, followed by a probe trial on day 6.

## Cutoff
Any trial in which the animal has not located the platform by 60 seconds is guided to the platform and the latency is recorded as 60 seconds.

data.title: Drug Administration Form
data.description: Record of each investigational or comparator drug administration.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete **each time** an investigational or comparator compound is administered, including vehicle controls.

## Vehicle administrations
For vehicle, enter the vehicle composition as the Drug Name (e.g., "0.9% Saline", "DMSO 10% in PBS").

data.title: Terminal Tissue Collection Form
data.description: End-of-study euthanasia and tissue collection record.
data.instructions:
## When to complete
Complete **at the time of euthanasia and tissue harvest**.

## Sample identifiers
Enter one Tissue Sample ID row for each distinct sample collected (e.g., left hemisphere, right hemisphere, spinal cord, serum aliquot). Ensure each ID is unique within the study.
